title: Team
description: Employees of this workspace and their roles. A workspace can have several Owners.
lastOwnerCannotDemote: The last Owner cannot be demoted

roleDescriptions.OWNER: Full access including team, billing-ready settings and integrations.
roleDescriptions.ADMIN: Manages clients, forms, documents, employees and settings.
roleDescriptions.MEMBER: Works with assigned clients: uploads, reviews and sends reminders.

dialog.title: Invite an employee
dialog.description: They receive an email with a link to join this workspace.
dialog.messagePlaceholder: Add a short personal note to the invitation

removeConfirm.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeConfirm.description: They lose access to this workspace immediately and are unassigned from their clients. Their past activity stays in the audit log.

revokeConfirm.title: Revoke invitation?
revokeConfirm.description: The link sent to {{email}} stops working.
